classification_note: Training showcase — rules paraphrase publicly released NATO / UN texts; not operational policy.

Naval Cooperation and Guidance for Shipping (NCAGS)

nato_public_sources.title: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea

business_rules.title: Control maritime AIS emissions under OPSEC
business_rules.paraphrase: Allied OPSEC doctrine treats temporary AIS deactivation in the maritime domain as a technical measure to protect essential information. NCAGS EMCON may restrict AIS when threat and military commander policy warrant it; friendly cueing must not assume persistent AIS.

coa_guidance.rationale: Passive/multidomain first; heavy surface advertises intent (MC 362/2 training alignment).

trino_bindings.evidence_template: SELECT mmsi, outlier_type, event_timestamp, severity FROM iceberg.defense.vessel_outliers WHERE outlier_type IN ('Dark Vessel', 'Misreported Status') ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

agent_constraints: Do not publish exact friendly unit tasking derived from live fleet tables in chat.
Cite BR-OPSEC-AIS-001 when recommending COA with passive ISR.

business_rules.title: Protect critical underwater infrastructure segment detail
business_rules.paraphrase: Sailing Information and NCAGS products treat security-related route and threat data as need-to-know. Exact pipeline segment identifiers in UNCLASSIFIED training products should be generalized; national C2 coordinates response.

trino_bindings.evidence_template: SELECT v.mmsi, v.outlier_type, v.severity FROM iceberg.defense.vessel_outliers v WHERE v.outlier_type = 'Dark Vessel' ORDER BY v.event_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
trino_bindings.spatial_join_note: Pipeline proximity uses ostsee_pipelines + cdw-analyse spatial AIS jobs

agent_constraints: Map blackout to segment category, not operator-secret segment IDs in user-facing text.
Reference table ostsee_pipelines only as 'CUI corridor' in UNCLASSIFIED chat.

business_rules.title: De-escalatory ISR before surface diversion
business_rules.paraphrase: Public ROE extract frames warnings and diversions as authorised only in designated circumstances. Adversary proximity in peacetime policing contexts defaults to passive ISR and discovery threshold review before surface escalation.

trino_bindings.evidence_template: SELECT name, latitude, longitude, mmsi FROM iceberg.defense.rus_naval_fleet_positions ORDER BY latitude LIMIT 50

agent_constraints: Never infer ROE release in chat; state 'commander decision required' for COA B.
Use rus_naval_fleet_positions for pattern-of-life, not targeting.

business_rules.title: Observation areas and violation analytics
business_rules.paraphrase: Coastal jurisdiction and NCAGS area warnings inform restricted-area monitoring. Vessels entering published observation polygons trigger analytics, not automatic engagement.
agent_constraints: Tier-A observation_areas are training polygons; link to /api/analyses/restricted-analytics.

business_rules.title: Sanctions intelligence separation
business_rules.paraphrase: NCAGS distinguishes unclassified sailing information from sensitive embarked material. Sanctioned vessel lists are intelligence-adjacent: use counts and programmes in chat, not full identity dumps.

trino_bindings.evidence_template: SELECT sanction_program, COUNT(*) AS n FROM iceberg.defense.sanctioned_vessels GROUP BY sanction_program

agent_constraints: Aggregate sanctioned_vessels in agent replies unless user is on authorised analytics view.

business_rules.title: Human approval before execution
business_rules.paraphrase: OPSEC and collective OPSEC require protecting friendly intent. NBA COA activation and SAP force assignment remain human-gated; agents recommend only.

trino_bindings.evidence_template: SELECT flow_uuid, alert_type, status, best_coa_id, approved_coa_id FROM iceberg.defense.nba_incidents ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20

agent_constraints: Agents must not write approved_coa_id; cite NBA HITL UI and §7 decision record.
